verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an official CUDA Toolkit development environment for GPU-accelerated applications and an NVIDIA AI Enterprise software stack (including NIM) for AI development and deployment on the H200. A community report also shows production LLM inference running on H200 SXM. However, nothing names PyTorch or any other mainstream ML framework, and no support matrix is cited. Framework support is therefore only implied through the CUDA and AI Enterprise stack. Missing for 10: explicit PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX support statements, an officially documented framework build or support matrix listing H200/Hopper, and independent hands-on confirmation of mainstream frameworks running on H200.
